notable_features.text: Dutch is a West Germanic language, closely related to German and English, and is the ancestor of Afrikaans, which developed from Cape Dutch dialects and remains partially mutually intelligible with it. It has a large phoneme inventory of 58 sounds and marks two tense/aspect categories grammatically, but unlike many languages it has no single dominant word order.
